verdict.rationale: Paddle documents its own card-acceptance path. Overlay checkout needs 'minimal frontend coding' (paddle-docs-14), Paddle.js inline checkout covers one-time and subscription purchases (paddle-docs-1, paddle-docs-13), and a Next.js starter kit ships with integrated checkout (paddle-docs-51). A solo founder also reports taking payments through it (paddle-comm-2). Nothing in the pack shows how long it takes to go from signup to accepting live payments, and the sandbox explicitly does not accept real payments (paddle-supp-sandbox). Missing for 10: evidence of live-account approval or onboarding time, proof that a first live card payment is achievable within a day, and independent hands-on time-to-first-payment reports.
